overview: A WhatsApp-style messaging web app where people sign in, find each other by name, and chat one-to-one in real time.
features: Sign in and set up a profile with a display name and photo
Search for other people by display name
One-to-one conversations with a chat list sorted by recent activity
Send and receive text messages with timestamps and live refresh
Unread message counts that clear when a chat is opened
Responsive layout that works on mobile and desktop
